title: trace-grounded interaction groups and recovery attribution

claim.to_prove: Groups of observed Taiji interactions can explain contribution, complementarity, conflict, and recovery benefit on unseen workflows without predefined neuron-role labels.
claim.must_not_claim: A statistical group is not a hard-coded planning/ memory/ language neuron class and does not become a global controller.

input.group_candidates: Derived from contribution, complementarity, conflict, recovery effect, and resource cost; no semantic role string is an input feature.

output.update_rule: Write only to the owning policy or memory surface after validation; never replace the whole executive with a group table.

trace.provenance: Every attribution must point to the exact trace digest, checkpoint revision, split, and evaluation seed.
trace.determinism: Fixed trace corpus, split, seed, and estimator revision produce stable group IDs and attribution ordering.

checkpoint.continuation: After restore, replay must not reassign a group to a different owner without new evidence and a new revision.
checkpoint.approval: No group admission is an approval to execute a write action.

red_proof: hard-coded role list creates a passing group
evidence.holdout: Use unseen task compositions and an independent outcome split; holdout evaluation is read-only and cannot add evidence to the learner.
evidence.lesion: Leave one group out, remove one member, and disable attribution; each lesion must produce an interpretable change or fail closed.
evidence.cross_seed: Require consistent direction and uncertainty intervals across independent seeds before admitting a high-order group.

failure_isolation.trace_drift: Reject attribution when trace digest or checkpoint revision is stale.
failure_isolation.low_confidence: Keep candidate unadmitted; do not guess an owner.
failure_isolation.resource_pressure: Stop evaluation and preserve parent group registry; never trade away checkpoint identity.

rollback.path: restore parent group/policy checkpoint, append rejected or rolled-back candidate tombstone, and return evaluation budget
rollback.atomicity: Group registry and owner-policy update commit atomically with the admitting checkpoint revision
rollback.recovery: Re-evaluate only from a fresh trace revision; old positive results cannot silently revive a rolled-back candidate.

boundary: Do not name groups by imagined biological roles.
Do not let a group table select tools, external MCP actions, or provider artifacts.
Do not call correlation a causal result without lesion or counterfactual evidence.
